description: This file defines the RevolutionLog class, which manages and interprets revolution timing data, including parsing revolution data from a string, calculating crank angles based on time, and providing access to the stored revolution data.

classes.name: RevolutionLog
classes.description: A class that encapsulates revolution timing data, providing methods to parse revolution logs, compute crank angles, and access revolution data.

methods.name: parseRevolutions
methods.description: Parses a string containing revolution data into a RevolutionLog instance.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the revolution log.

methods.name: getCrankAngleByTimeString
methods.description: Returns the crank angle as a formatted string based on the provided time.

methods.name: angle2string
methods.description: Converts a crank angle to a formatted string, handling NaN cases.

methods.name: getCrankAngleByTime
methods.description: Calculates the crank angle in degrees based on the given time.

methods.name: doGetAngle
methods.description: Internal method that computes the crank angle, trying to estimate angle over multiple revolutions if needed.

methods.name: getTimeAndRpm
methods.description: Retrieves the RPM and time entry for a given timestamp.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns the set of all timestamps (keys) in the revolution log.
